label: Validate CSV rows and insert them into PostgreSQL
description: Read a CSV file called 'cities.csv' and iterate through it. If a line contains both 'City' and 'Country' values, log them and insert them into PostgreSQL table 'CITY', otherwise just log a warning. After that, make a query counting the number of records inside table 'CITY' and log it.

tasks.label: Load a csv file from local machine
tasks.name: filesystem_1
tasks.description: Reads cities.csv from the machine running ByteChef (self-hosted only). Set the file's full path.

tasks.label: Read from CSV file data pill
tasks.name: csvFile_1
tasks.description: Parses the file as CSV with a header row, producing one record per line with City and State values.

tasks.label: Loop through CSV rows
tasks.description: Goes through each CSV record and either stores it in the database or logs a warning.
tasks.name: loop_1

iteratee.label: If 'City' and 'State' are present
iteratee.description: Checks that the current record has both a City and a State value.
iteratee.name: condition_1

caseTrue.label: Log
caseTrue.description: Record is complete: logs the line and its city name.
caseTrue.name: logEntry1

caseTrue.label: Store columns into a database
caseTrue.name: postgresql_1
caseTrue.description: Record is complete: inserts it into the public.CITY table, with City as the name column and State as the country column.

caseFalse.label: Log Warning
caseFalse.description: Record is missing a value: logs a warning with the record and skips it.
caseFalse.name: logEntryWarn1

tasks.label: Query a database
tasks.name: postgresql_2
tasks.description: After the loop, counts the rows in the CITY table.

tasks.label: Logger
tasks.description: Logs the total number of records now in the CITY table.
tasks.name: logger_1
